dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Category field to rank (customer, product, SKU…)

dataRoles.name: measure
dataRoles.description: Numeric measure to concentrate (sales, revenue, liters…)

dataRoles.name: comparison
dataRoles.description: A second measure to compare with, e.g. last year's sales. Each period is ranked on its own.

dataRoles.name: panel
dataRoles.description: One Pareto per value of this field: plant, region, product line.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Additional measures to display in tooltips

binSizePct.description: Each bar represents this % of entities. Free tier fixed at 20% (5 bins). Pro: 1–20%.

trimLower.description: Remove the bottom N% of entities (outliers) before calculating bins.

trimUpper.description: Remove the top N% of entities (outliers) before calculating bins.

barColor.description: Fill color for all bars. Supports rule-based conditional formatting (fx): each bar takes the resolved color of its top-ranked entity.

ibcsMode.description: Apply International Business Communication Standards styling (neutral colors, clean contrast, standardized IBCS palette)

thresholdColors.description: Color bins by where they fall relative to a cumulative % threshold.

show.description: Overrides Bar color. Bins are colored by whether their cumulative % is within the threshold.

thresholdValue.description: Cumulative percentage that separates the vital few from the trivial many. Defaults to 80.

highlightCrossing.description: Emphasize the bin in which the cumulative line crosses the threshold.

ref1Value.description: Draw a reference line where cumulative value reaches this %.

show.description: One sentence above the chart: how many entities make the threshold share of the total.
Shade class A, B and C behind the bars: A makes the first cut of the total, B up to the second, C the rest.
